facts.text: The hotel is on a beachfront spot along the Herbert Samuel Boardwalk, with views of the Mediterranean coastline.
facts.excerpt: ideally located on a prime beachfront spot along the Herbert Samuel Boardwalk, offering breathtaking views of the Mediterranean coastline

facts.text: The hotel is located directly on the beach, with the Mediterranean Sea a few steps from the rooms.
facts.excerpt: Our Tel Aviv hotel is located directly on the beach, with the beautiful Mediterranean Sea only a few steps from your room.

facts.text: The hotel is within walking distance of the artists' quarter and Jaffa.
facts.excerpt: we are conveniently situated within walking distance of the city's vibrant hotspots, the artists' quarter, and the picturesque Jaffa

facts.text: The White City of Tel Aviv, a UNESCO World Heritage site, is 3 km from the hotel.
facts.excerpt: Only 3 km from the Hotel, you will spot the White City of Tel Aviv, which is a major historical monument and is a UNESCO World Heritage site.

facts.text: Sea view rooms include a balcony and views of the Mediterranean.
facts.excerpt: Enjoy Tel Aviv Sea view rooms that include a balcony and views of the Mediterranean at our hotel.

facts.text: The suites look out over the deep blue Mediterranean and its white sandy beaches.
facts.excerpt: Unwind from your very own luxurious Tel Aviv hotel suite with a spectacular view of the deep blue Mediterranean and its white sandy beaches.

facts.text: The Sheraton Grand Club Lounge is on the 18th floor, is adults-only and has sea views.
facts.excerpt: Sheraton Grand Club Lounge, 18th floor: Adults-only with sea views

facts.text: The Club Lounge is open to Club and Suite guests only.
facts.excerpt: dairy breakfast, dinner, drinks & cocktails- Club & Suite guests only.

facts.text: The hotel has one outdoor pool on-site for hotel guests.
facts.excerpt: Yes, Sheraton Grand Tel Aviv has one Outdoor pool on-site for hotel guests.

facts.text: The outdoor pool is seasonal.
facts.excerpt: Seasonal Outdoor Pool

facts.text: The pool bar offers views of the beach and the Mediterranean Sea.
facts.excerpt: Relax, read, sunbathe, and sip cocktails at our pool bar in Tel Aviv while enjoying views of the beautiful beach and Mediterranean Sea.

facts.text: The fitness center is a fully equipped Technogym fitness center.
facts.excerpt: Fully equipped Technogym fitness center

facts.text: The Palm Restaurant serves a daily breakfast buffet and a traditional Shabbat dinner overlooking the Mediterranean.
facts.excerpt: Enjoy a daily breakfast buffet and a traditional Shabbat dinner overlooking the Mediterranean.

facts.text: Manara, on the Lobby Level, offers an interpretation of local Israeli culinary culture with Mediterranean influence.
facts.excerpt: Located on the Lobby Level, Manara offers an interpretation of the local Israeli culinary culture along with broad Mediterranean influence.

facts.text: The &More lobby is a communal space designed for gathering and community.
facts.excerpt: The &More lobby at Sheraton Tel Aviv is a vibrant communal space designed to celebrate gathering and community.

facts.text: The hotel is pet-friendly and eco-friendly.
facts.excerpt: our hotel is pet-friendly and eco-friendly

facts.text: The hotel's concierge can arrange tours for guests.
facts.excerpt: Our hotel may organize several tours for its guests.

facts.text: The minimum age to check in is 18.
facts.excerpt: Minimum Age to Check In: 18

facts.text: Smoking is prohibited in all hotel rooms, balconies and public areas.
facts.excerpt: Smoking is strictly prohibited in all hotel rooms, balconies, and public areas.

facts.text: Staff speak Hebrew, English, Russian, French and Spanish.
facts.excerpt: Hebrew, English, Russian, French, Spanish
